## Synthesis · Synthèse {background-color="#1B4332"}

- Pollination: selfing vs. outcrossing, delivered by abiotic or
  biotic agents
- The flower is a complex communication center with signals (vs. cues) and rewards 

- The plant-pollinator relationship spans a spectrum from deception,
  through robbing, to the tightest obligate mutualisms.
- It reshapes species over both short and long evolutionary time
